$schema-note: Test cases for the Engineering Intake Engine. Each case feeds `input` to a fresh IntakeSession and checks the resulting brief. Only the keys present in `expect` are checked. Field ids look like 'material.componentCount'.

keys.known: { fieldId: value } — status KNOWN with exactly this value
keys.inferred: { fieldId: value } — status INFERRED with exactly this value (never a fact until confirmed)
keys.review: { fieldId: value|null } — status REQUIRES_ENGINEER_REVIEW; null = no value may be stored (ranges, bounds, qualitative statements)
keys.userUnknown: [fieldId] — the user said they do not know it yet
keys.conflict: [fieldId] — two different stated values: no value, both kept as candidates
keys.next: { field, mode? } — the single next question
keys.notAsked: [fieldId] — must never be asked, even when every question is skipped
keys.missing: { fieldId: reason } — present in the missing list with that reason
keys.missingRequiredEmpty: true — no REQUIRED field is missing
keys.flags: [review flag id or id prefix] — must appear in the engineer review notes
keys.rfq: { contains: [text], notProvided: [label] } — RFQ draft checks (runs of spaces collapsed)
keys.knownCount: number of KNOWN fields in the brief
keys.notice: substring of an info notice shown to the user

cases.name: Spec example 1 — 500 modules/hour, two-component epoxy
cases.input: We need to pot 500 electronic modules per hour using a two-component epoxy.

cases.name: Spec example 2 — 10:1 epoxy at 100 cc/min (component count only inferred)
cases.input: We use a 10:1 epoxy and need 100 cc/min.

cases.name: Spec example 3 — automated dispensing of polyurethane
cases.input: We need automated dispensing of polyurethane.

cases.name: Spec example 4 — manual dispensing of silicone into electronic housings
cases.input: We manually dispense silicone into electronic housings.

cases.name: Spec example 5 — 2,000 parts per week (thousands separator, encapsulation)
cases.input: We need to encapsulate 2,000 parts per week.

cases.name: Spec example 6 — a robotic potting system (automation level is inferred, not stated)
cases.input: We need a robotic potting system.

cases.name: Spec example 7 — three components with a 1:1:1 ratio
cases.input: We have three components with a 1:1:1 ratio.

cases.name: Spec example 8 — "We don't know the viscosity yet."
cases.input: We don't know the viscosity yet.

cases.name: Demo case (LOAD DEMO CASE)
cases.input: We need to automatically pot 500 electronic modules per hour using a two-component epoxy. The material is mixed at 10:1 and we dispense approximately 15 grams per part.

cases.name: Ratio written as "10 to 1" with a final period
cases.input: We use a 2 component epoxy mixed 10 to 1.

cases.name: "2-part" system and flow written as "100 cc per minute"
cases.input: The epoxy is a 2-part system, 100 cc per minute.

cases.name: Qualitative viscosity ("high viscosity") never becomes a number
cases.input: Our resin has high viscosity and we pot about 30 parts per minute.

cases.name: Viscosity by role word (resin / hardener): assigned to A / B as INFERRED only
cases.input: Resin viscosity is 5000 cP and hardener viscosity is 200 cP.

cases.name: Viscosity per named component
cases.input: The viscosity of component A is 5000 cP and component B is 200 cP.

cases.name: Conflicting ratios in one message
cases.input: We mix it 10:1, actually maybe 5:1, not sure.

cases.name: Shot size as a range is not a value
cases.input: We dispense between 10 and 20 grams per shot.

cases.name: "Up to" is a bound, not a production rate
cases.input: We need up to 600 parts per hour.

cases.name: Negation plus explicit manual wording
cases.input: The process is not automated, operators dispense by hand.

cases.name: Single-component silicone, semi-automatic: ratio does not apply
cases.input: We use semi-automatic dispensing for a one-component silicone.

cases.name: Two components stated but a three-term ratio: ask, do not guess
cases.input: We use a two-component epoxy with a 1:1:1 ratio.

cases.name: Filled material, temperature with unit, decimal comma
cases.input: The material is silicone, glass-filled, heated to 60 °C, with a shot of 1,5 g.

cases.name: Four components: custom / higher-complexity context only
cases.input: We have four components.

cases.name: Out-of-scope application (bonding) is flagged, not silently accepted
cases.input: We need to bond windshields with an adhesive.

contains: may belong to a different application

cases.name: Nothing technical in the text: nothing is invented
cases.input: hello

cases.name: Gibberish: nothing is invented
cases.input: asdf qwerty 123

cases.name: Production rate as a range
cases.input: We run 400-600 parts per hour.

cases.name: Robot arm, "10 to 1 by weight", 2-part polyurethane, shots per minute
cases.input: We dispense with a robot arm, 10 to 1 by weight, 2-part polyurethane, 3 g per shot, 20 shots a minute.

cases.name: Complete description: no REQUIRED field is missing
cases.input: We pot 500 control modules per hour with an automated robotic cell. The two-component epoxy is mixed 10:1 by volume. Component A viscosity is 8000 cP and component B is 300 cP. Shot size is 12 g per part and the flow rate is 100 cc/min. The modules are PCBs in plastic housings and the line is on a clean factory floor.

cases.name: Hazardous environment is flagged for the engineer, not assessed
cases.input: The potting area is an explosive atmosphere, ATEX zone 1.

cases.name: Negated robot and conveyor
cases.input: We have no robot and no conveyor.

cases.name: Cycle time in seconds
cases.input: The cycle time is 12 seconds.

cases.name: "100k parts per year"
cases.input: We make 100k parts per year.

cases.name: Two different component counts in one message
cases.input: We use a two-component epoxy, actually three components.

cases.name: Abrasive / thixotropic are flagged, never asked or assessed
cases.input: The material is abrasive and thixotropic.

cases.name: A bare "500 per hour" is a number without a unit noun: inferred
cases.input: We need about 500 per hour.

cases.name: Shot written as "2.5 ml shots"
cases.input: We pour 2.5 ml shots.

cases.name: "15 g of epoxy" is not necessarily per part: inferred
cases.input: We use 15 g of epoxy.

cases.name: A clock time is not a mix ratio
cases.input: Our shift starts at 10:30 and we use epoxy.

cases.name: "500 to 600 parts per hour" is a range, not a ratio
cases.input: We make 500 to 600 parts per hour.

cases.name: Mix ratio only: component count inferred from the number of terms
cases.input: Mix ratio of 100:1.

cases.name: Single component but a ratio too: the ratio is not hidden, it is flagged and asked about
cases.input: We use a single component epoxy mixed 10:1.

cases.name: Viscosity range in cP is not a value; the unit alone is kept
cases.input: The viscosity ranges from 3000 to 5000 cP.

cases.name: Quantities with 'an hour' and 'a minute' phrasing
cases.input: We pot 120 modules an hour, about 2 g per part.

cases.name: "Approximately" and "about" stay visible in the brief and the RFQ
cases.input: We pot approximately 500 parts per hour, about 15 g per part.
